Extend these systems through skill specializations, technique discovery, crafting mastery and material traits, enemy adaptations, faction access and branching quest rewards. Keep ordinary skills useful at later stages: farming can grow alchemical herbs, cooking can support breakthrough preparation, and environmental skills can unlock routes or resources. Each expansion should create an observable choice or interaction, not just another XP bar. ### 2. Several connected forms of progression Proposed character tracks: body conditioning, energy cultivation, soul development and comprehension. Skill mastery can unlock techniques and specializations; equipment mastery can unlock refining, inscriptions and evolving artifacts. Faction standing can unlock mentors, research and facilities. A home or sect can develop gardens, workshops, training grounds and expedition support. Use breakthroughs as gameplay transitions with visible requirements and preparation options. Combine training, materials, discoveries or a trial rather than requiring only a larger number. Provide alternative routes for combat, crafting and exploration builds. Separate travel, ascension and rebirth. Travel changes place without a reset. Ascension opens a higher layer of play. Rebirth is an optional, clearly explained reset with explicitly retained knowledge, discoveries or chosen legacies. Show losses and retained progress before confirmation. Exact retention and balance need playtesting. ### 3. Worlds with different rules These are candidate original settings, not committed names or a claim of implemented content: | World family | Distinct play | Progress it can contribute elsewhere | |---|---|---| | Mortal frontier | Trades, martial schools, survival and local factions | Foundational skills, manuals and contacts | | Cultivation realm | Energy affinities, alchemy, formations and breakthroughs | Techniques, spiritual resources and refining | | Arcane world | Spell research, schools and enchantment | Spell patterns and alternative energy conversions | | Beast wilderness | Ecology, taming and adaptation to habitats | Companions, biological materials and resistances | | Industrial or technological world | Engineering, automation and crafted augmentations | Devices, production knowledge and expedition tools | | Oceanic or sky world | Navigation, pressure or altitude, vehicles and routes | Mobility, rare resources and environmental mastery | | Dream or spirit world | Soul trials, perception and memory | Insights, soul techniques and unusual artifacts | | Ruined or hostile world | Scarcity, hazards and relic expeditions | Recovery expertise and lost technologies | | Higher planes | Synthesis of paths, domain-building and difficult trials | Advanced specializations and new world interactions | Worlds should differ in available energy, hazards, economy, factions, resources, access conditions and rewards. Use shared systems where they fit and world-specific rules where they change decisions. A technological world should not be a cultivation location with renamed enemies. Treat worlds as both branches and tiers: some are alternative destinations at similar strength, others require a breakthrough. Keep visited worlds relevant through recipes, research, relationships and optional challenges. Avoid making every older area mandatory daily upkeep. ### 4. Define compatibility, costs and tradeoffs rather than letting every imported ability dominate every world. Permanent knowledge, maps, recipes, technique familiarity and faction history can form a discovery layer across journeys. Companions and a home base can connect these systems, but should follow the core loop rather than become a separate unfinished game. ### 5. # Paradise hub candidate: a place to live between journeys

Status: nested campaign implementation selected, 2026-10-05, under [current packet](../../gm/dispatch/NESTED_WORLDS_AND_DEEP_TROPE_CHAINS_2026_10_05.md) and sole Features coordinator01a10dc5. The supplied English MTL reading is complete: [FULL_SYNTHESIS](../../research/novels/trailblaze-reading/paradise-depth/FULL_SYNTHESIS.md) and [completion checkpoint](../../research/novels/trailblaze-reading/paradise-depth/CHECKPOINT.md) qualify all4,505distinct bodies/151duplicate dependencies over4,656spine members. Original canon/publication/translation fidelity remain unauthenticated. The earlier unrun Qidian-page attempt is historical provenance, not the current supplied-edition reading state. Source dossier/library are read-only. Native implementation and later behavioral/director acceptance remain separate. [Nested interface](../../gm/feature-wave/features/nested-campaign/INTERFACE.md) owns selected early-service-footprint rules and original branch divergences.

The user asked whether Paradise can be a world to absorb, progress and live in, while supporting bounded visits. The proposed **Wayfarer Exchange** remains original content that can test this structure before a selected direct novel adaptation. This candidate does not replace the vanilla opening or add a second playable realm/prestige.

## Residence connects to journeys

An optional earned passage/invitation leads to a durable settlement with lodging, workshop, practice, recovery, public records, traders and travelers with their own means. Residence is more than a mission-selection screen. A small owned place stores actual goods, teaches routines, supports research/refit and preserves specific relationships.

Proposed roles: specialist traveler, craftsperson, route researcher, broker, healer/support worker or institution builder. Missions can fund parts and discoveries; ordinary work can fund travel without becoming a combat career. A high-power character retains their strength while suppliers, source compatibility, useful research and people still create choices.

Existing original Exchange people stay their own characters: Iona's ledger authority, Venn's partial maps and Kes's competing route work are defined in the framework. A returned traveler can bring actual evidence about a danger rather than selling omniscient lore. Rivalry can close, become cooperation or continue under specific remembered events.

## Bounded scenario and deeper world are compatible

An assignment selects an existing local arc, entry profile, era/region, objective, known terms, extraction and settlement. The destination campaign supplies its own institutions, people, powers and consequences. Completing extraction may leave its civil conflict unresolved; the issuer's receipt cannot declare that every local person was saved.

An initial mission can represent one region. Later residence, discoveries and earned routes can expose more of that same instance; reentry does not regenerate its starting reward or erase its people. An explicitly different timeline is a different causal instance with source-qualified identity/age/body/support.

[Multiverse scope](../MULTIVERSE_STRUCTURES.md) distinguishes cosmology, represented coverage and persistence. A bureau can reach genuine independent worlds, a region within one, nested realms or constructed trials; each selects its actual connection and state policy. Several independent networks can coexist. A small assignment is not evidence that its destination exists only for that assignment.

The full campaign dossiers remain useful for coherent places outside the represented region and future expansion. A small first delivered scenario does not require simulating every off-screen actor. Its scope is declared before commitment; an extraordinary action that reaches beyond that scope needs a real expanded adapter or an honestly scoped scenario rule.

## Distinct progression and project proposals

Training develops actual retained methods/control; a workshop develops tools/modules/refit; research tests cross-world materials/functions; licensed service develops local access and obligations; a home develops storage/collaborator capacity. None is a global compulsory progression ladder or automatic power-conversion marketplace.

A project chain: ordinary repair work funds a bench; the bench lets the traveler calibrate an acquired sensor; a funded visit returns a genuine sample and paid damage; inspection identifies an incompatible coating; testing creates a useful local seal recipe; that recipe improves a supported return mission. Another player can buy the calibration service and pursue a different career.

Strong acquisitions can be genuinely superior. Specialized local requirements still need actual source/body/fuel/authority; the hub cannot manufacture a soul-bound release by charging generic coins. Cross-world hybrids are paid original experiments with observable uncertainty and retained evidence.

## Calendar, failure and interruption

The hub has durable played-time life and commitments under the shared scheduler proposal. Each destination declares absence and return policy; [origins/timelines](../ORIGINS_AND_WORLD_TIMELINES.md) distinguishes calendars, traveler duration and bodies. No browser-closed advance or universal outside-world decay is selected.

Known mission terms precede acceptance. A refused offer creates no debt. A coerced/judgment scenario needs its actual institution/authority and explicit scope; a hidden optional objective does not create retroactive accepted obligations. Severe assignments may fail or lose a body under a selected failure contract; ordinary defeat, extraction failure, life ending and prestige remain separate.

Native safe-boundary travel exists only as a planner foundation; it does not implement live destination restoration, interrupted extraction, household/body starts or rescue during active jobs. Private saves remain untouched.

## First build and source gate

First design proof: one optional residence/workshop contact, one ordinary paid preparation, one region's two-route assignment, real return cargo/knowledge, and a later remembered meeting/refit. Destination native instance/save/absence bindings and staged costs/custody come first. The current one-realm/one-prestige milestone is still the delivered baseline.

To become a direct Reincarnation Paradise adaptation, select actual chapter/edition evidence for hub life, progression, travel, settlement, source retention and mission consequences. Until then this is an original source-inspired structure, not canon reproduction. Final roster, name, mission grade, durations and loss/retention need selection/playtest, with implementation/browser/save evidence unrun.

Checkpoint: master captured user request and specialist recommendation locally; no active hub GM or code writer. [Framework](../CAMPAIGN_FRAMEWORK.md), local campaigns and origin/ability/interaction contracts retain their owners. Next: review a bounded source set or implement the original one-region return proof after the shared native-world gate, without declaring all external campaigns complete.
